**Turn potion boosts into exact upgrade completion times.**

A fast, offline Android timer for Clash of Clans. Enter how much time an upgrade has left, add the potions you plan to use, and get the exact finish date and time — no account, no ads, no tracking.

### ⬇️ [Download Upgrade-Timer-Calc-v1.1.0.apk](https://github.com/ajvillam0r/coc-upgrade-timer-calculator/releases/download/v1.1.0/Upgrade-Timer-Calc-v1.1.0.apk)

---

## Features

| | |
|---|---|
| **Simple timer** | Add days, hours and minutes to the current time and see the exact finish moment. |
| **Builder Potion** | 10× boost for 1 hour per potion. Enter potions used, or the boost time you have left. |
| **Research Potion** | 24× boost for 1 hour per potion, with the same two input modes. |
| **Pet Potion** | 24× boost for 1 hour per potion for Pet House upgrades. |
| **Built-in keypad** | Large on-screen number pad on every calculator — the soft keyboard never covers the form. |
| **Floating overlay** | Float the calculator on top of the game and keep playing while you do the maths. |
| **Set Alarm** | Hands the computed finish time straight to your phone's clock app. |
| **Works 100% offline** | Everything is bundled in the APK. No connection needed after install. |
| **Light & dark** | Follows your system theme automatically. |

---

## Install

1. Tap the download link above (or expand **Assets** and grab the `.apk`).
2. Open the downloaded file on your Android device.
3. If prompted, allow installs from your browser or file manager, then tap **Install**.
4. Open **Upgrade Timer Calc**.

**Requires Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer · ~4 MB**

The application ID is `com.ajvillam0r.upgradetimercalc`, so this installs alongside any other calculator app and will not overwrite it.

### Permissions

| Permission | Why |
|---|---|
| Display over other apps | Only for **Float Mode**. Requested the first time you tap it. |
| Set alarm | Only for **Set Alarm**, which opens your clock app with the time pre-filled. |
| Foreground service | Keeps the floating bubble alive while the overlay is open. |

Nothing is sent anywhere. The `INTERNET` permission is declared by the app shell but the calculators never use it.

## iPhone, iPad and desktop

The same app runs as an offline web app — no install required:

👉 **[Launch Upgrade Timer Calc](https://ajvillam0r.github.io/coc-upgrade-timer-calculator/)**

- **iPhone / iPad:** open the link in **Safari** → **Share** → **Add to Home Screen**
- **Android Chrome:** menu → **Install app**
- **Desktop Chrome / Edge:** install icon in the address bar

Float Mode and Set Alarm are Android-only and stay hidden on the web build.
